notes.title: Tiny Hands Adventure patch 1.0.4 is now live!
notes.notes:
Tiny Hands Adventure just got a free content update!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32836230/5773520e00b445ccbee1b7f0a858868db0f60844.jpg

Patch notes:

- new secret stage (High In The Sky) 
- Game Hub now shows crystals collected in each stage
- added indication of Hard Level unlock
- movement and jump speed adjusted
- reworked jump mechanics for better gameplay value
- adjusted brightness of some maps
- adjusted collisions with enemies
- new effects (attack, hit, collect)
- new collectable heart look

notes.title: "Stone Summer" patch now live!
notes.notes:
Tiny Hands Adventure just got updated to version 1.0.1!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32836230/ba5df4dfca0d4e1c1b8bdd97f6a87dd2c59db19b.jpg

New content:
- new stage "Stone Summer" in a new section (Area 6) available to play after obtaining all white (hard) crystals in the game.

Adjustments:
- exploding boxes now have yellow color
- in level select hub stage we now have visible Orange Gems for levels that have it collected
- balanced some platforming sections in game

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32836230/2ae1297f620c48a9e6f4ee3c2f67e195ff627c34.jpg

Fixes:
- fixed some collision bugs
- fixed some camera issues
- fixed some minor problems
- fixed some bugs with using Mecha Hands
- fixed bugs with instant killing 3rd and 4th boss
